### resource

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `resource.account` | `string` | Account ID the resource is in. |
| `resource.region` | `string` | Region. Empty for account-wide resources such as IAM roles. |
| `resource.type` | `string` | CloudFormation type, such as `AWS::EC2::VPC`. Empty when the layer's type has no mapping. |
| `resource.source_type` | `string` | The layer's own type name, such as `codedeploy:deploymentconfig`, when the CloudFormation type is unknown. |
| `resource.tf_types` | `list(string)` | Terraform resource types that map to the CloudFormation type. |
| `resource.arn` | `string` | ARN, when the layer gives one. |
| `resource.id` | `string` | The layer's resource ID, such as AWS Config's `resourceId`. |
| `resource.name` | `string` | Name, or the name in the ARN when the layer gives none. |
| `resource.tags` | `map(string, string)` | Tags. An empty map when the resource has none, so `"k" in resource.tags` works. |
| `resource.attrs` | `map(string, string)` | Identifiers a layer read, such as `is_default` or `role`. Read one with `resource.attrs.?key.orValue("")`. |
| `resource.layer` | `string` | The first layer that reported the resource, such as `config`. |
| `resource.sources` | `list(string)` | Every layer that reported the resource, in precedence order. |
| `resource.parents` | `list(Related)` | Parent resources. |
| `resource.relationships` | `list(Related)` | Every related resource, the parents included. |
| `resource.created` | `string` | Creation time in RFC 3339, when the layer knows it. |
